transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Back in 2025 I took that quick rail trip from Beijing over to Shanghai, and it still cracks me up how chaotic the station felt at rush hour.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I also remembered this Chengdu leg from that same year—everyone kept talking about how there were way more attractions than we could realistically squeeze in.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For the Beijing–Shanghai part, my coworker had already gotten me on train D321 for 2025-03-19, so I didn’t have to deal with any of the ticket stuff myself.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The ticket was under Feng Jie, and they’d picked First Class—honestly, that extra space saved me after a long week.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And in Chengdu, my friend said they’d already sorted the Giant Panda Base visit for 2025-05-27 in the afternoon—Emma Taylor’s name on it, and it was for 4 people.
